findings.evidence: PDF/Model.lean:100 `def modelPdf (Flavor) (a b : ℕ) : Pdf Flavor := fun _ x _ => Set.indicator (Set.Icc 0 1) (betaShape a b) x`; PDF/Model.lean:87 `betaShape a b x = x ^ a * (1 - x) ^ b`; PDF/Basic.lean:245 `def weight (w : ι → ℝ) (f : Pdf ι) : Pdf ι := fun i x Q2 => w i * f i x Q2`.
findings.fix: Define `threeQuarkPdf := PDF.weight (fun s => if s = .quark () then 6 else 0) (PDF.modelPdf (Species Unit) 0 1)` (importing `EpsilonEridani.Particles.Parton.PDF.Model`) and keep the three evaluation lemmas as consequences of `weight_apply` and `modelPdf_apply`.
findings.issue: `threeQuarkPdf` is a bespoke redefinition of an existing general model: `PDF.modelPdf (Species Unit) 0 1` is `Set.indicator (Icc 0 1) (1 - x)` and `PDF.weight w f i x Q2 = w i * f i x Q2`, so `threeQuarkPdf = weight (fun s => if s = .quark () then 6 else 0) (modelPdf (Species Unit) 0 1)`. The `@[simp]` evaluation lemmas (lines 274-285) are then the existing `weight_apply`/`modelPdf_apply` at `w`.

findings.evidence: PDF/Model.lean:141 `modelPdf_momentIntegrable`; PDF/Model.lean:209 `mellinMoment_modelPdf_zero_one : mellinMoment (modelPdf Flavor 0 1) n i Q2 = ((n + 1) * (n + 2))⁻¹`; PDF/Basic.lean:254 `mellinMoment_weight`; PDF/ChargeConjugation.lean:153 `valenceNumber f i Q2 = mellinMoment f 0 (.quark i) Q2 - mellinMoment f 0 (.antiquark i) Q2`.
findings.fix: After the redefinition above, derive `integrableOn_threeQuarkPdf` from `PDF.modelPdf_momentIntegrable _ 0 1 0` (restricted to `Icc 0 1`) and `valenceNumber_threeQuarkPdf` from `valenceNumber_def`, `PDF.mellinMoment_weight` and `PDF.mellinMoment_modelPdf_zero_one` at `n = 0`: `6 * (1 * 2)⁻¹ - 0 = 3`.
findings.issue: `integrableOn_threeQuarkPdf` (383) and `valenceNumber_threeQuarkPdf` (393) re-prove by hand, for this one density, facts the repo already has in general for `modelPdf`/`weight`: moment integrability and the closed-form moments of the shape `1 - x`.

summary: The abstract sum-rule material and the UnitTriangle file sit at the right level with no unused or over-strong hypotheses. The single-parton side of the three-quark model, however, re-defines and re-proves a special case of the repo's existing general PDF model (`PDF.weight` applied to `PDF.modelPdf _ 0 1`).
